contexts.text: To bind up the wounds () = the healing of the injury done to the affection of truth.
To bind up the wounds, and pour in oil and wine = to prepare a remedy against the falsities which have injured its life...
Not bound up, not mollified with oil () = not amended through repentance, and tempered through good.
The reformation of doctrine through truths is signified by Jehovah shall bind up the breach of His people ().
